{{Top|leg}}
'''Bridgeman''' was the owner of a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] owner during the [[Great Peace of the Republic|Republic era]]. He had hired the father of future [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] [[free-trader]] [[Axtor Bridgeman]] as crew on a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] in exchange of the man's excellent repair skills.<ref name="GG6-1">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>

After his father had advanced through the ranks on Bridgeman's vessel, Axtor was given the opportunity to accompany him on one of the trips. That experience sold the young boy on becoming a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]].<ref name="GG6-1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bridgeman first appeared in [[West End Games]]' ''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]'' as part of [[Axtor Bridgeman]]'s backstory. Despite not being outright stated, it's possible that young Axtor took 'Bridgeman' as a surname in honor of the man who had hired his father.
